newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Nanpu bridge gets half of investment back.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Nanpu bridge gets half of investment back.

text.p: Shanghai's Nanpu Bridge, opened in 1991 to connect the east and west banks of the Huangpu River, has already recovered half of its 820 million yuan investment, the Xinhua news agency reported on Friday.

The agency said more than 60 million vehicles had passed over the bridge since it opened and traffic has soared in recent years, reaching 61,000 a day last year. The toll fee, payable in one direction only, is 13 yuan for an ordinary car.
The bridge is part of a large plan to develop transport links between the main Shanghai city area and the new Pudong development zone across the river. ($1 = 8.3 yuan)
